answers.how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_deviceness_asks_health.py:71 (root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="testing-deviceness-asks-")), landed under f78a1a09e8ff). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. The standing door proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py (ticket b2abaa16e590) already reds over these lines; its PROVES gains this ticket's key on the same tooth test_no_proof_in_tools_base_reaches_temp_bare, so the crossing names it. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
answers.what: Every proof in cairn/tools/base takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a tools/base proof makes outlives its run.
